# Assignment 3 - Hypothesis testing (due Fri Oct 23){#assignment-3b}


Find, in the published literature, two mean values with associated
standard deviations and sample size, where it is reasonable to test a hypothesis that the means are equal.

1. Report the 6 values with full citation of source of the published data.
2. Compute the t-statistic using the appropriate formula. State which formula you used and why.
3. Use the generic recipe for decision making with statistics ([Ch7.3](https://davidcschneider.github.io/StatisticalScience/LNotes/Pt2/Ch7_3.pdf), Table 7.1 on p2) to declare a decision about the two means. Some of the points requested on the generic recipe are a bit confusing. Please do your best. One sentence for each of the 10 points listed.
